name: Nine Entertainment Co. Holdings Limited
summary: Nine Entertainment Co. Holdings Limited engages in the broadcasting and program production on free to air television, broadcast video on demand, and subscription video on demand in Australia. The company operates through Streaming & Broadcast, Publishing, and Outdoor segments. It is involved in the operation of a broadcast network through linear television, including Channel 9 for news, entertainment, and sport destinations; 9GO! for entertainment, reality, comedy, and blockbuster movies; and 9Life, a lifestyle destination.
